metadata.description: Name of the azd environment; drives resource naming.
Object ID (oid) of the user/SP running azd up. Used to grant Grafana Admin and AKS RBAC. Leave empty to skip role assignments.
When true, AKS API server is exposed only inside the VNet (private cluster). Defaults to false so kubectl works from your laptop.
When true, provisions Application Gateway for Containers (AGFC) via the ALB add-on. Disable for fast hands-on sessions (~20 min faster).
When true, deploys Application Gateway v2 as a fast L7 ingress (parallel with AKS, no addon needed). Ignored when enableAgfc=true.
When true, creates Azure Monitor Private Link Scope (AMPLS) with private DNS zones and PE. Disable for fast provisioning (~5 min faster).
Number of AKS user-mode nodes for the default system pool.

variables.grafanaName: [substring(format('graf-{0}-{1}-{2}-{3}', variables('workload'), variables('envShort'), variables('locationShort'), variables('uniqueSuffix')), 0, min(23, length(format('graf-{0}-{1}-{2}-{3}', variables('workload'), variables('envShort'), variables('locationShort'), variables('uniqueSuffix')))))]

properties.description: Allow inbound HTTP from Internet to AKS subnet.
Allow inbound traffic to nodejs LoadBalancer service.
Allow inbound traffic to python LoadBalancer service.
Allow inbound HTTP from Internet to AGFC subnet.
Allow inbound HTTPS from Internet to AGFC subnet.
Required for AppGW v2 health probes from Azure infra.

properties.subnets: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'aks-subnet', 'properties', createObject('addressPrefix', '10.240.0.0/22', 'networkSecurityGroup', createObject('id', resourceId('Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups', variables('aksSubnetNsgName'))), 'privateLinkServiceNetworkPolicies', 'Enabled'))), if(parameters('enableAgfc'), createArray(createObject('name', 'aks-appgateway', 'properties', createObject('addressPrefix', '10.240.8.0/24', 'networkSecurityGroup', createObject('id', resourceId('Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups', variables('agfcSubnetNsgName'))), 'delegations', createArray(createObject('name', 'agfc-delegation', 'properties', createObject('serviceName', 'Microsoft.ServiceNetworking/trafficControllers')))))), createArray()), if(parameters('enableAppGw'), createArray(createObject('name', 'appgw-subnet', 'properties', createObject('addressPrefix', '10.240.4.0/24', 'networkSecurityGroup', createObject('id', resourceId('Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups', variables('appGwSubnetNsgName')))))), createArray()))]
